{{Top|leg}}
'''Base Derilysa''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military base located on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Derilysa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. It was the largest military base on the planet.
